protocol.array_accounting: m² core +32n vector/index allowance +64KiB library/Python reserve +one kernel tile +both packed feature arrays. Selection keeps one256² core plus old64² core; transpose dger and Cholesky aliases asserted.
protocol.timing_exclusions: Tracemalloc run and independent dense validation are separate; same-final oracle omits acquisition and is not a timing win.

Concrete and growth paths were not independently traced; their cap evidence is source accounting and alias checks, not a universal RSS cap. Common immutable X,b and diagnostic result storage are outside the algorithm cap.
post_run_audit.checkpoint_note: Executed checkpoint branch verifies but does not stop immediately on convergence at exactly10. Source preserved unchanged; every completed solve required more than10 iterations.
post_run_audit.phase_note: phase_seconds.transition is an unused zero field. prefix_and_transition_seconds records the actual full cumulative checkpoint cost, including selection, enlarged-core setup, reconstruction, and true-residual verification.
